title: Two Makita cordless drills and two Makita chargers in red storage compartment
objects_and_counts: Two cordless power drills with visible 'Makita' branding: one positioned near the upper centre (mostly visible) and one positioned at lower left (rotated, with chuck pointing right).
Two battery charger units with visible 'Makita' branding located on the right side of the compartment: one at upper right and one at lower right.
Two battery packs visibly attached to the drills (one attached to each drill).
Two power cords visible, both associated with the chargers; both cords are coiled and lie on top of or beside the chargers.
No people are visible in the photographed scene.

The scene is a single enclosed red compartment or drawer with visible side walls and base; no additional equipment or furniture is visible beyond the drills, batteries, chargers and cords in this compartment.
spatial_relations: The compartment is rectangular with red interior surfaces; the two drills occupy the left and central upper-left areas while the two chargers occupy the right side.

One drill lies horizontally at lower left with its chuck pointing right toward the compartment centre; the second drill is positioned near the upper centre with its handle pointing down-right and chuck pointing left.
The two chargers are stacked in the right half of the compartment: one charger sits at upper right and the other at lower right, with their cords coiled on and around them.
Battery packs are attached to the base of each drill; each battery is located adjacent to the drill handle and between the drills and the chargers when viewed across the compartment.
There are small white square labels or tape pieces along the left inner wall and near the right edge of the compartment (these appear affixed to the red interior).
colours_and_materials: The interior of the compartment is painted a glossy red.
Both drills are teal blue and black with white 'Makita' logos; they have black plastic chucks and black textured grips and silver metal belt clips.
The chargers are primarily black with teal-blue 'Makita' branding panels and multicoloured indicator markings on the charger face.
Power cords are black rubber-insulated cables coiled on the chargers.
uncertainties: Small printed text on the charger faces and battery labels is partly obscured or too small to fully transcribe; 'DC10SB' on the lower right charger is legible but additional charger specification lines are unreadable from this view.

The exact numeric sequence on the torque ring(s) is partly legible ('1 2 4 6' and '20' observed) but some intermediate characters may be obscured or out of frame; '1 2 4 6' was transcribed as seen but may be incomplete.
The exact printed battery specification is partly legible as '2.0Ah' on at least one battery pack; other battery label details are not fully readable.
There may be additional small labels or model numbers on the tools and chargers that are not fully legible at this image resolution.
The left-most drill lies close to the left edge of the image and is slightly rotated; parts of it near the left edge may be cropped by the image border.
